worldcombat.skill.autotomize.summary: The user pries off useless shell pieces and flings them away: it becomes much lighter and sharply faster. Inside the light window gravity is reduced, so it jumps higher and falls more slowly - that is how being light shows in the world, and standing still it still rests on the ground. The shed pieces scatter and vanish moments later; they are not pickable resources, and they do not grow back.
worldcombat.skill.autotomize.use.0: Shed once before a fight to raise Speed
worldcombat.skill.autotomize.use.1: Speed up while chased, then choose to pursue or flee
worldcombat.skill.autotomize.use.2: Jump higher during the light window to cross small height steps
worldcombat.skill.autotomize.description: Shedding raises Speed by %1$s stage(s), which is not taken back when the light window ends; about %2$s pieces are flung at roughly %3$s blocks/tick and scatter away moments after landing, leaving no pickable resource.
The light window lasts about %1$s; while it holds, gravity is reduced by %2$s so the body jumps higher and falls more slowly (it does not hover in place).
worldcombat.skill.autotomize.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.autotomize.growth.0: At level %1$s the light window extends to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.autotomize.growth.1: At level %1$s the light window extends further to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
The companion considers shedding only when a threat is within this distance; larger means earlier preparation.
Below this distance the companion stops shedding and deals with the threat; larger gives up the boost more often up close.
